reuseDecision.existingProjectNetworkProbe: Reuse tools/sp01-network-probe for CloudBase application round trips; it does not inject network impairment.
reuseDecision.adoptedCandidate: Use Pakomo's existing ordered-broadcast automation protocol for condition readback; do not write a second traffic shaper.
reuseDecision.adaptation: Read-only protocol review only. No product dependency, source patch, command dispatch, VPN activation, CloudBase call, or phone file write was performed.
reuseDecision.compatibility: Static source is from the already-built and installed kernel debug package for Huawei SEA-AL10 Android 10; protocol operation on the current phone remains unverified in this review.

lightPresetSource.scopeAndSelectedApplications: Persisted Pakomo selection; the command response returns scope but does not echo selected package names.

startCommand.confirmedSemantics: With wait=true, source waits for the exact applied config ID and forwarding stage before returning confirmed=true.

diagnosticLimitations: status counters aggregate shaped traffic and do not identify the CloudBase endpoint or a specific sample request.
start confirms the requested config was applied but does not echo the exact numeric parameters or selected package list.

A screenshot of the Pakomo rule/app selection plus start/status result timestamps can correlate the test condition, but is not an independent measurement of link RTT, throughput, jitter, or packet loss.
Every successful status response has local Logcat and status-file side effects; the status file is overwritten, not an append-only history.

sequence: capture the active-app selection and light preset in Pakomo
start light with wait=true and require confirmed=true, stage=forwarding, scope=applications, appliedRule=light
run exactly one already-authorized 30-call read-only CloudBase sample and record start/end wall-clock times
read status and preserve counters and timestamp
stop with wait=true, require inactive, and verify network recovery
